tool_input.command: cd C:/Users/<user>/Downloads/auto_ontology_nvidia/p8; for q in "misread correction" "git push force" "typed user message characters" "tool calls model Haiku" "question followed by Bash" "kill by pattern" "over-building correction" "kill by PID" "correction hits" "input validation rejected" "denied tool calls" "stopped early" "project corrections" "cost US dollars"; do echo "=== $q"; python -I search.py L0 "$q"; done

H="FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0"
docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -t -c "
SELECT 'c03', count(*) $H AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5
UNION ALL SELECT 'c06', count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id=8
UNION ALL SELECT 'c09', count(*) FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars >= 400
UNION ALL SELECT 'c12', count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.model='claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'
UNION ALL SELECT 'n03', count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1,2) AND c.model='claude-fable-5'
UNION ALL SELECT 'n06', count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) $H AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11
UNION ALL SELECT 'n09', count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (3,4)
UNION ALL SELECT 'n12', count(*) $H
UNION ALL SELECT 'n15', count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=r.call_id WHERE r.validation_mark
UNION ALL SELECT 'm03', round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.model='claude-opus-4-8')/count(*),2) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1,2)
UNION ALL SELECT 'm06', round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tool_name='Bash')/count(*),2) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=r.call_id WHERE r.denied_mark
UNION ALL SELECT 'm09', count(*) FROM (SELECT h.msg_id $H GROUP BY h.msg_id HAVING bool_or(p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11) AND bool_or(p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15)) x
UNION ALL (WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT 'c15', count(*) FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name = 'Bash' AND NOT t.is_sidechain))
"
